concepts.name: 意境 (Artistic Conception / Yijing)
concepts.description: The highest ideal of Chinese art, fusing objective scenes with subjective emotion into an integrated whole.

sub_concepts.name: 虚实相生 (Interplay of Virtual and Real)
sub_concepts.description: The dynamic interaction between the tangible/painted (real) and the empty/unpainted (virtual) spaces.

sub_concepts.name: 空灵与充实 (Ethereal and Solid)
sub_concepts.description: The aesthetic balance where profound richness is achieved through sparse, suggestive expression.

concepts.name: 诗画分界 (Boundary between Poetry and Painting)
concepts.description: The relationship and distinctions between temporal arts (poetry) and spatial arts (painting).

concepts.name: 静照 (Static Contemplation)
concepts.description: A tranquil, detached state of mind required to appreciate and create true beauty.

concepts.name: 移情与距离 (Empathy and Psychological Distance)
concepts.description: The need for both emotional projection and objective detachment in aesthetic appreciation.

concepts.name: 空间意识 (Space Consciousness)
concepts.description: How different cultures perceive and represent space, contrasting Chinese fluid space with Western geometric space.

sub_concepts.name: 中西画法比较 (Comparison of Sino-Western Painting Techniques)
sub_concepts.description: Analysis of linear perspective vs. scatter perspective and focus.

concepts.name: 道、舞、空白 (Dao, Dance, and Blank Space)
concepts.description: The philosophical roots of Chinese art where rhythm (dance) and emptiness express the Dao.

concepts.name: 禅境 (Zen Realm)
concepts.description: The influence of Zen Buddhism on art, emphasizing spontaneity, simplicity, and awakening.

concepts.name: 书法美学 (Calligraphic Aesthetics: 用笔、结构、章法)
concepts.description: The foundational role of calligraphy in Chinese visual arts, encompassing brushwork, structure, and composition.

concepts.name: 魏晋风度与晋人之美 (Beauty of Jin Dynasty People)
concepts.description: The pursuit of individual expression, naturalness, and philosophical grace during the Wei-Jin period.

concepts.name: 音乐寓言与音乐美学 (Musical Fables and Aesthetics)
concepts.description: The role of music as the ultimate expression of harmony and emotion in ancient philosophy.

concepts.name: 高贵的单纯与静穆的伟大 (Noble Simplicity and Quiet Grandeur - Greek Aesthetics)
concepts.description: Winckelmann's description of classical Greek art, serving as a comparative baseline.

concepts.name: 民族精神 (National Spirit in Tang Poetry)
concepts.description: The robust, expansive, and vital cultural spirit reflected in Tang dynasty literature.
